correctness.rationale: For exact softplus fixed-point equilibrium with 0<q<1, slopes t,s∈(0,1) are freely realizable by biases. A one-unit recurrence yields H1=t(1−t)/(1−qt)^3, derivative zero uniquely at t*=1/[(1−q)+sqrt((1−q)^2+q)], giving asymptotic δ²sup H1→4/27. For triangular W=[[q,0],[q,0]], output second unit has H2=s(1−s)/(1−qt)^2 + q s t(1−t)/(1−qt)^3. Maximizing s gives s*=(1−qt²)/[2(1−qt)] and envelope (1−qt²)^2/[4(1−qt)^4]. Ratio (1−qt²)/(1−qt)^2 strictly increases with t, giving exact supremum 1/[4(1−q)^2] as t→1, not at any finite bias. Two independent copies in 2D multiply to det Hessian sup 1/[16(1−q)^4]. The comparison ratio 4 to the source 1/64 coefficient is architecture-specific, not a new global sharp upper bound. Independently checked derivative/algebra and representative finite q values; actual symbolic verifier source was inspected.
